name: TabArena
description: A benchmark for evaluating tabular machine-learning models across a collection of datasets and tasks. TabArena is a benchmark note, not a single downloadable table; dataset availability and terms vary across its constituent tasks.
citation: Erickson, N., Mueller, J., Shirkov, A., et al. (2025). TabArena: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on Tabular Data. arXiv:2506.16791. https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.16791

license.identifier: Not specified as a single standard SPDX identifier
license.notes: TabArena is a benchmark suite whose constituent datasets may have different licenses and access terms. No single standard SPDX identifier applies to the benchmark as a whole; check the benchmark repository and each dataset's terms before use or redistribution.
